# Export Requirements Quality Checklist: Postman Collection Generator

**Purpose**: Validate that AP-007's requirements are complete, unambiguous, consistent, and
measurable across secret handling, determinism and traceability, the validation gate and scope
boundaries, and the export experience — before task breakdown begins.
**Created**: 2026-09-03
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)
**Audience / Timing**: Specification author, self-review prior to `/speckit-tasks`

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Security & Secret-Handling Requirements

- [ ] CHK001 Are the criteria by which a value is "recognized as a credential" defined in the specification, rather than left to implementation judgement? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-013]
- [ ] CHK002 Do FR-003 (reproduce request data "exactly as approved") and FR-013 (replace recognized credentials with variable references) state which one prevails when an approved body legitimately contains a credential-shaped literal? [Conflict, Spec §FR-003, §FR-013]
- [ ] CHK003 Is "diagnostic output" defined with enough precision to know what it covers — server logs, error response bodies, validation problem messages, or all three? [Clarity, Spec §FR-025]
- [ ] CHK004 Is FR-024's retention limit ("beyond what the export itself requires") expressed as an objectively checkable condition rather than an open-ended qualifier? [Measurability, Spec §FR-024]
- [ ] CHK005 Are the requirements that decide which declared variables are marked sensitive stated, or only that the marking exists? [Completeness, Spec §FR-010, §FR-011]
- [ ] CHK006 Does the specification define how a "deliberately marked secret" is designated in an evaluation case, so SC-004 can be objectively evaluated? [Measurability, Spec §SC-004]
- [ ] CHK007 Is the handling of a supplied base address specified consistently — placed only in the environment artifact while the collection references the variable — across FR-008, FR-011, and User Story 2? [Consistency, Spec §FR-008, §FR-011, §US2 AS3]
- [ ] CHK008 Are requirements defined for supplied variable values that name a variable the collection does not reference, given the contract treats this as a validation error? [Gap, Contract §POST /api/test-models/postman-collection]
- [ ] CHK009 Are requirements stated for the accompanying document's own secret hygiene, or is SC-004's inclusion of that document unsupported by any functional requirement? [Coverage, Spec §SC-004, §FR-016]

## Determinism & Traceability Requirements

- [ ] CHK010 Is "identical artifacts" defined as byte-identical serialized output or as semantic equivalence? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-018, §SC-002]
- [ ] CHK011 Are requirements defined for how generated identifiers are derived, so that no run-scoped value (random id, timestamp, machine detail) can defeat FR-018? [Gap, Spec §FR-018]
- [ ] CHK012 Does the specification state the conditions under which SC-002's repeatability holds — repeated runs in one process, across processes, across machines, or across locales? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002]
- [ ] CHK013 Is the deterministic fallback grouping defined, or only required to exist? [Completeness, Spec §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK014 Are the deterministic disambiguation rules for colliding folder and request names specified, including the tie-breaking key? [Clarity, Spec §FR-005]
- [ ] CHK015 Is the ordering key for folders, requests, checks, and variables specified, given that stable ordering is itself a requirement? [Gap, Spec §FR-018, §US4 AS2]
- [ ] CHK016 Does FR-026 state where origin information is preserved — inside the collection artifact, in the accompanying document, or both? [Clarity, Spec §FR-026, §SC-011]
- [ ] CHK017 Is "the difference is limited to the affected scenario" expressed in objectively comparable terms rather than as an intuitive diff expectation? [Measurability, Spec §US4 AS1]
- [ ] CHK018 Are US4 AS3 (declared variable set stays stable for unchanged scenarios) and FR-010 (declare every variable the collection references) reconciled for the case where removing a scenario removes the last reference to a variable? [Conflict, Spec §US4 AS3, §FR-010]

## Validation Gate & Scope Boundary Requirements

- [ ] CHK019 Is "the expected collection format" identified precisely enough at specification level to make FR-014 verifiable, or is the format left entirely to the plan? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-014, §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK020 Does the specification state the rule distinguishing a blocking validation failure from a non-blocking recorded limitation? [Gap, Spec §FR-014, §FR-015, §FR-017, §FR-021]
- [ ] CHK021 Are the invariants that validation must check enumerated in the requirements, or only that validation occurs? [Completeness, Spec §FR-014]
- [ ] CHK022 Does FR-030 decide between rejecting and reporting workflow-bearing input, rather than permitting either? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-030]
- [ ] CHK023 Are requirements defined for how multi-step workflow intent is detected before AP-008 supplies the workflow contract? [Gap, Spec §FR-029, §FR-030]
- [ ] CHK024 Is the outcome specified for a scenario referencing an operation absent from the supplied API model, given the data model defines this as a refusal? [Gap, Data model §Failure outcomes]
- [ ] CHK025 Is the concurrent-export edge case backed by a functional requirement, or does it appear only as an edge case with no requirement to satisfy? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK026 Are SC-010's measurement conditions defined — hardware class, warm or cold start, and what "fails explicitly" means at that boundary? [Measurability, Spec §SC-010]
- [ ] CHK027 Does the no-network requirement cover every activity during export, including reference resolution and schema retrieval, rather than only calls to the API under test? [Coverage, Spec §FR-023, §SC-012]
- [ ] CHK028 Is the empty approved test set classified as a successful outcome or a failure outcome, consistently between FR-020 and FR-027's state list? [Consistency, Spec §FR-020, §FR-027]

## Export Experience & Artifact Documentation Requirements

- [ ] CHK029 Does FR-017's enumeration of known limitations cover every limitation category the edge cases and data model imply, including undocumented status codes, unresolved path parameters, and a selected alternative authentication requirement? [Completeness, Spec §FR-017, §Edge Cases, Data model §GenerationLimitation]
- [ ] CHK030 Is the origin vocabulary used for the counts-by-origin report defined and aligned with the provenance the approved test model actually carries? [Clarity, Spec §FR-016, §US3 AS4]
- [ ] CHK031 Does FR-022 specify what "a single export action" delivers — three separate files, one bundle, or one response — so the requirement is verifiable? [Clarity, Spec §FR-022, §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK032 Are the contents of the recovery guidance shown on export failure specified, or only that guidance is present? [Clarity, Spec §FR-027]
- [ ] CHK033 Are accessibility requirements defined for the export action and its loading, empty, and failure states? [Gap, Spec §FR-027]
- [ ] CHK034 Does SC-008 define the evaluation method, participant population, and what counts as "locating the requests", so the 90%/30s target can be measured? [Measurability, Spec §SC-008]
- [ ] CHK035 Does SC-007 identify the collection runner and version against which "import and run with no manual edits" is judged? [Clarity, Spec §SC-007]

## Dependencies, Assumptions & Cross-Artifact Consistency

- [ ] CHK036 Is the assumption that the parsed specification carries no server address validated, and is the required behaviour stated for a specification that does declare one? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions, §FR-008]
- [ ] CHK037 Is the dependency on AP-006's approval semantics documented precisely enough that "approved", "pending", and "rejected" are unambiguous inputs to FR-002? [Dependency, Spec §FR-002, §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK038 Is the assumption that assertion checks are limited to the assertion types the test model already carries reflected in a requirement, or stated only as an assumption? [Traceability, Spec §Assumptions, §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK039 Are the variable naming conventions the assumptions rely on defined somewhere citable, rather than described as an established convention without a source? [Traceability, Spec §Assumptions, §FR-010]
- [ ] CHK040 Do the specification, the API contract, and the data model agree on request shape, optionality, and failure outcomes, with no behaviour defined only in the contract or only in the data model? [Consistency, Contract, Data model §Failure outcomes]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- Items tagged `[Conflict]`, `[Ambiguity]`, or `[Gap]` are the natural candidates for a `/speckit-clarify` round before `/speckit-tasks`
- Add comments or findings inline
